label: Kennel
literalRoomDescription: This room looks like it was once a kennel for a very large dog (some of the bones would fit a dinosaur). It apparently hasn't been used for a long time, as the dust is fairly thick all over. The only exit is northeast.
safeSceneProfile: Long-disused giant-dog kennel with thick dust and dinosaur-sized old bones; only northeast exit. No new dog actor or collectible bones.
